part.text: I used the wrong path. The `submission/` directory is relative to the task workspace, not the filesystem root.

Wrote `submission/main.c`.

Structure:
- `work_item` initialized with `k_work_init()` in `main()`, bound to `worker_function` which prints "Work executed"
- `K_TIMER_DEFINE(one_shot_timer, timer_expiry_function, NULL)` — no stop function needed
- `timer_expiry_function` runs in ISR context, so it only calls `k_work_submit(&work_item)` and defers the printk to the system work queue
- `k_timer_start(&one_shot_timer, K_MSEC(1000), K_NO_WAIT)` — the `K_NO_WAIT` period is what makes it one-shot; a non-zero period would make it rearm
- `k_sleep(K_MSEC(3000))` then prints "Done" and returns 0

I didn't compile this: there's no Zephyr SDK or west workspace in this directory, so the code is unverified against a build. The APIs used match the standard Zephyr kernel timer/work interfaces.
